title: What a Bird Thought
subject: English
summary: “What a Bird Thought” is a poem about a little bird and its experiences as it grows up. At first, the bird lives in a small shell and thinks that the whole world is dark and small. One day, it comes out of the shell and sees the beautiful world around it. It discovers trees, flowers, the sky and many other wonderful things. As the bird grows, it learns more about the world and enjoys its freedom. The poem teaches us that the world is full of beautiful things, and we should be curious and explore new experiences.
